name: Bao Nguyen
headline: Full-stack Web Developer
bio_md:
I build web and mobile apps from end to end: the API, the database, the screens people use, and the servers they run on.

I build software for TL Portraitz, a wedding photo and video studio. I built its booking system: public booking and gallery pages, payments, and a Flutter app for the team. I also build NarraFlo, a project tool for video work, and parts of NarraNetwork, a set of shared services for sign-in, records and video calls. Most of that work is TypeScript, with Fastify, Hono, SvelteKit, React, PostgreSQL and LiveKit.

On my own projects, I write Go. I rebuilt this site as a Go API and a SvelteKit app, with its own admin, blog editor, email threads and analytics. I built [spotify-tracker](https://listening.baoopn.com), a set of Go services that log every song I play and show it live. I also built sites for AT Creations, a handmade gift and ceramics store, and MUBEN, a fashion brand. I host most of it myself on Coolify, behind Cloudflare.

Not all of my work happens at a desk. I shoot weddings as a videographer and photographer, so I know what a studio needs from its software. A wedding gives you one chance at each moment. It teaches you to plan ahead and stay calm.

I also work as a restaurant server. The job keeps me quick on my feet, and it reminds me that good service starts with paying attention to people. On the tech side, I set up the online reservation system for Saigon Taste, a restaurant in Edmonton.

If you have a project in mind, send me a message.
